semantics.timing: Pure combinational next-state and Moore output logic; no clock, registers, or stored state.
semantics.reset_initialization: External FSM begins in S at reset; this module has no reset port and no initialization mechanism.

numeric.types: All ports unsigned Boolean bits except unsigned state[9:0].
numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise Boolean logic only; no arithmetic, rounding, overflow, or saturation.

verification.oracle: Independent transition-table case model for each of the ten legal one-hot states; compare requested next-state indicators and Moore outputs.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all ten legal states and eight combinations of d, done_counting, ack (80 checks).
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; preserve logs.
verification.static_review: Check exact interface, bit mapping, combinational drivers and lack of inferred storage.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for zero-hot, multi-hot, or X/Z states is not specified. Implement direct one-hot equations without added recovery or priority behavior.
